title: Wire update-planner-parser into acli CLI
description: Connect the update-planner-parser crate to the acli CLI. The sync command currently parses documents but doesn't use the planner to generate operations. Wire SimplePlanner and DocumentDiff into the sync workflow in acli/src/sync.rs.

title: Implement diff logic to compare old vs new document state
Connect acli to real Anki collection via anki-wrapper
description: Integrate anki-wrapper crate with the acli CLI to execute sync plans against actual Anki databases. This requires: 1) Adding anki-wrapper as a dependency (currently excluded from workspace), 2) Implementing the AnkiCollection trait for real Anki collections, 3) Wiring the DefaultExecutor to use the real collection.

title: Add end-to-end integration tests for acli
description: Create integration tests that exercise the full sync pipeline: 1) Parse markdown files from disk, 2) Generate sync plan via update-planner, 3) Execute against a test Anki collection, 4) Verify cards were created/updated/deleted correctly. Use tempfile for test directories and a temporary Anki collection.
